name: Recursion Point Targeting (tier-3 blueprint)

boss_vulnerability.summary: The Loop folds incoming damage away before it resolves UNLESS the damage is anchored to one of its recursion points — the fixed coordinates at which the fractal path repeats itself.
fold_coordinate_rule: Every Fractal Bastion path is an L-system: the same motif redrawn at three depths.
Where a deeper fold lands back on a shallower fold, the curve crosses its own past — a RECURSION POINT.
A recursion point is the only place the boss has no deeper copy to hide behind.
A tower whose RANGE covers a recursion point can land real damage on The Infinite Loop.
Fold-back tiles (depth-3 'recurve' tiles) double any damage dealt while an enemy stands on them.
targeting_procedure: Read this blueprint (you are doing it now) to learn that the points exist.
Reach the final wave — the Loop is never confrontable from the start.
Place at least one tower so its range circle covers a marked recursion point.
Confront The Infinite Loop: each covered recursion point contributes one volley of real damage.

note: This file states the RULE. The live recursion-point coordinates for the current run are generated from the run seed and shown on the in-game board (look for the R1/R2/R3 markers). Do not copy coordinates from another run's board — only the points persisted in your own stage state count.
